Class JetsonInputs

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.subsystems.vision.JetsonInputs
All Implemented Interfaces:
LoggableInputs
public class JetsonInputs extends Object implements LoggableInputs
The Jetson Orin's own topics, as an AdvantageKit input: board health (issue #10, 9a and the throttle addition), Rewind status (4, 7a), the Jetson's settings (11a) and the active excluded-tag list (11b). Logged under /Vision/Jetson/.... NaN / -1 / empty until first published.
